items.desc_now: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness: five agent tools (list, create, inspect, remove, prune) plus a working-location picker in the New Session row and a settings panel. Refuses to remove a worktree with uncommitted or untracked changes, and never removes the main one.

DSH web plugin: conversation outline panel - user questions (index, time, per-turn stats) as root nodes with the assistant reply's Markdown headings beneath; three width tiers, density rail, search scope, bookmarks, Markdown export, section jump, keyboard nav, reading-position memory. Read-only UI.
items.desc_prev: DSH web plugin: conversation outline panel - history questions (index + time) plus the assistant reply Markdown heading tree, with level slider, search, bookmarks, copy and click-to-jump.

items.desc_now: Ctrl+F find bar for the DSH desktop app: it searches the whole conversation, not just the messages already on screen.
items.desc_prev: DSH web plugin: a Cmd/Ctrl+F find bar for the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell that searches the WHOLE conversation, not just the rendered tail.
